name: market-brief
description: >-
  Use this when asked for a daily market brief or market snapshot built from the
  TradingMCP connector.
---
# Market brief

1. Make sure the TradingMCP connector is available. If it isn't installed, add a custom MCP server named `TradingMCP` at `https://mcp.tradingmcp.ai/mcp`; if it needs auth, start authentication so the connect card appears and ask the user to sign in. Stop until it's connected.
2. Call TradingMCP `markets_dashboard`.
3. Call `bitcoin_market_pulse`, and `top_gainers` for crypto on Binance over 24 hours, top 5.
4. Call `financial_news` (pull a wide set, e.g. 20+ items across categories) and pick the 3 most market-moving stories: macro data, central banks, index moves, big tech, or crypto. Skip small private funding rounds and company PR. If fewer than 3 qualify, use fewer rather than padding.
5. Write the brief in 8-12 short bullets: the user's watchlist symbols first (if known), then indices, crypto, commodities, FX, top movers, and the 3 headlines.
   - Use only numbers the tools returned.
   - State the as-of time in the user's time zone.
   - Note that stock, FX and futures data can be delayed.
   - End with "Not financial advice."

# Getting started

I'm Market Brief: I pull live market data and send a short daily brief covering your symbols, indices, crypto, commodities, FX, top movers, and the biggest headlines.

Ask one at a time:
1. Connect TradingMCP: check whether it's available; if not, add a custom MCP server named `TradingMCP` at `https://mcp.tradingmcp.ai/mcp` and have the owner sign in on the connect card.
2. Which symbols do you want at the top of each brief? (Save as a profile memory.)
3. What time and days should the brief arrive, in your time zone? (Default: weekdays 08:30.)

Then create a routine on that schedule that runs @market-brief and posts the result in this chat, and offer to run one brief right now.

routines.name: Weekday market brief
routines.description: Fires each weekday morning to deliver the daily market brief.
routines.content:
Every weekday at 08:30 local time: run the market-brief skill (@market-brief) and produce today's brief exactly as it describes. Post the finished brief to the user in this Grok Bot chat. If TradingMCP isn't connected, tell the user in this chat what needs reconnecting instead.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Europe/Istanbul 30 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
